section.subsection: A tax is imposed on a cannabinoid product at a rate of .10 multiplied by the retail price.

subsection.subsection: A licensee shall collect the tax imposed under Subsection (1) from a purchaser at the time the cannabinoid product is sold.
A consumer that purchases or receives an untaxed cannabinoid product shall pay the tax at the time the cannabinoid product is first received in this state.
